Do I need maybe to add installation of pyspellchecker to  https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark-containers/-/blob/master/development/ubuntu/Dockerfile ?

@geraldcombs - can you advise on how the pip wheel 'pyspellchecker' should get installed?  It won't install from .gitlab-ci.yml - should I install it as part of the DockerFile?

Any thoughts about whether this ought to be added to the pipeline are welcome from anyone.  It should run pretty quickly, but some files will generate lots of false positives.  And its only worth doing if people check it when (say) a new dissector has been added or substantially changed.

You should be able to add `pip3 install pyspellchecker` before running `check_spelling.py`. I do something similar in the weekly [automatic update](https://gitlab.com/geraldcombs/update-ws-numbers/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml) job.

We can also add this to the ubuntu-dev image, but I tend to avoid that if it's a dependency for a single job.
